name: apstat-park
description: AP Statistics course platform: Pages site (site/), quiz (site/quiz/), roster + relay Railway services (services/). Derived from two parent repos via sync/.

scripts.test: node -e "let failed=[];for(const s of ['site','park','quiz','roster','relay']){const r=require('child_process').spawnSync('npm',['run','test:'+s],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});if(r.status!==0)failed.push(s)}if(failed.length){console.error('FAILED suites: '+failed.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('all suites passed')"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix site run typecheck && npm --prefix services/roster run typecheck
